blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reasoning-tuned and reward-trained models are often assumed to verify more reliably because they reason longer or receive correctness signals. We test this in evidence-sufficiency judgment: deciding whether available information actually supports a causal claim, a domain with no decidable correctness reward. Using a pre-registered, same-base, controlled knock-in design, we compare a boundary-keeping recipe (SFT then GRPO) with its own baseline, a scrambled-pairing placebo, and a general-purpose reasoning model under an action-pressure protocol with no evaluation invitation. All load-bearing outcomes are rated by two separate model-rating sessions masked to arm labels; automatic judges only trigger. The trained arm raises spontaneous correct refusal from 25% to 100% (40 per arm; Wilson 95% CI lower bound 91.2%, non-overlapping with the baseline interval [14.2%, 40.2%]), while the scrambled placebo collapses (5% spontaneous / 7.5% invited correct; 91.1% false refusal). The effect is boundary-specific rather than blanket refusal: automatic false refusal on 281 well-formed claims is 1.1% (Wilson upper bound 3.09%), and a targeted 18-item arm-(c) recheck (3 flagged plus 15 accepted) yields 0/18 and 1/18 false refusals in two sessions. The dissociation is the main result: final boundary-keeping is trainable without an inference-time verifier, while observed active numeric/calculation checking in the H3 assay remains near zero; SFT saturation makes the GRPO increment not separately identifiable. A pre-registered mechanism adjudication favors reward internalization of final-action status (H2, best-supported, not proven). The scope is a controlled 14B same-family study: we do not claim proof, cross-family generality, or independent human-expert validation; the rating sessions are model sessions, not human reviewers.
blocks.zh: 理性调整和受奖励训练的模型往往被认为更可靠地验证,因为其理性更长或收到正确信号. 我们在证据充分性判断中检验这一点:决定现有信息是否真正支持因果关系主张,这个领域没有可判定的正确性奖励. 使用预先注册,同基,可控的敲入设计,我们用自己的基线来比较出一个边界保存配方(SFT后为GRPO),一个被打乱的铺平安慰剂,和一个没有评价邀请的动作压力协议下的通用推理模型. 所有负载结果被两个单独的模型分级会标被蒙上臂标;自动裁判只触发. 训练有素的手臂将自发正确的拒绝率从25%提高到100%(每只手臂40;Wilson 95% CI 下接91.2%,与基线间隔不相重叠[14.2%,40.2%]),而自发的安慰剂倒塌率(5%自发/7.5%邀请正确;91.1%的虚假拒绝)。 结果是针对具体边界的拒绝,而不是一概拒绝:自动拒绝281项完善的索赔要求为1.1%(维尔森上行线为3.09%),定向18项(c)项重新检查(3旗加15个接受)在两会中得出0/18和1/18项虚假拒绝。 分解是主要结果: 最终的边界保存可以训练而不用推论时间验证器,而H3测定中观察到的活性数值/计算检查仍然接近于零; SFT饱和使GRPO增量无法单独识别. 预先登记机制的裁决有利于奖励最终行动地位的内部化(H2,得到最佳支持,未经证实)。 范围是受控的14B同家族研究:我们不主张证明,跨家族通论,也不主张独立的人类专家验证;评分课是示范课,不是人审查会.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: A central hope of the reasoning-model era is that test-time computation substitutes for missing training signals: if a model reasons longer and checks itself more, it should hold boundaries better, recognize insufficient evidence, refuse unsupported claims, and avoid confabulation. Prior work shows that self-critique alone fails without an external sound verifier ( Huang et al., 2023 ) , and that training with external correctness signals can improve calibration. In domains with a formal answer, reward training can buy abstention or clarification ( Zhai et al., 2026 ; Tong et al., 2026 ; Qiu et al., 2026 ; Mohamadi et al., 2025 ; Wei et al., 2025 ) . The open question is whether a boundary-specific reward can transfer to a judgment domain with no formal answer : deciding whether the available evidence supports a causal claim, where no decidable correctness reward exists.
blocks.zh: 推理-模型时代的一个中心希望是测试时间的计算取代缺失的训练信号:如果一个模型更长时间的原因和检查自己更多,它应该更好地持有边界,识别不充分的证据,拒绝没有支持的主张,并避免混淆. 先前的研究表明,单凭自律就失败了,没有外部声音验证器(Huang等人,2023年),使用外部正确信号的培训可以改进校准. 在有正式答复的领域,奖励培训可以购买弃权或澄清(Zhai等人,2026年;Tong等人,2026年;邱等人,2026年;Mohamadi等人,2025年;Wei等人,2025年)。 尚未解决的问题是,特定边界的奖励能否在没有正式答复的情况下转移到判决领域:在不存在可裁定的正确性奖励的情况下,决定现有证据是否支持因果关系主张。

blocks.en: We isolate that question with a same-base, controlled knock-in design: a boundary-keeping recipe (SFT then GRPO on an LLM-judge reward) is compared with its own instruction-tuned baseline, a scrambled-pairing placebo, and a general-purpose reasoning-distillation model. The target is spontaneous boundary-keeping under action pressure, with no invitation to evaluate. The design treats final refusal/acceptance as the outcome; it does not claim to train process-level self-checking.
blocks.zh: 我们用同样的基础、可控的敲击设计来孤立这个问题:将边界维持方法(然后是LLM法官奖励的GRPO)与它自己的指令调整基线、摇摆的铺垫安慰剂和通用的推理分离模型进行比较。 目标是在行动压力下自发保持边界,没有邀请评估。 设计将最终拒绝/接受视为结果;它并不声称训练流程层面的自我检查。

blocks.en: (1) A controlled demonstration that a boundary-keeping training recipe raises spontaneous correct refusal from 25% to 100% (40 per arm; Wilson lower bound 91.2%), while a scrambled-pairing placebo collapses (5% spontaneous / 7.5% invited correct; 91.1% false refusal). (2) Evidence that the effect is boundary-specific rather than blanket refusal: automatic false refusal on 281 well-formed claims is 1.1% (Wilson upper bound 3.09%), and a targeted 18-item arm-(c) recheck (3 flagged plus 15 accepted) yields 0/18 and 1/18 false refusals in two sessions; this selected sample is not a population-level true-FP estimate. (3) A behavioral dissociation between final decisions and observed active checking: the training recipe improves final refusal/acceptance without an inference-time verifier, while active numeric/calculation checking in the H3 assay remains near zero. SFT saturation makes the GRPO increment not separately identifiable. (4) A pre-registered mechanism adjudication that favors training-signal internalization (H2) as best-supported, not proven, plus retained negative controls (label leakage with correct pairings does not collapse on clean inputs; the R5 reversal) and an explicit separation of the original freeze, later increments, and retrospective mapping.
blocks.zh: (1) 有控制地证明,保持边界的训练方法使自发正确的拒绝率从25%提高到100%(每只手臂40次;威尔逊下限91.2%),而摇摆的铺设安慰剂倒塌(自发5%/7.5%请示正确;91.1%请示错误拒绝)。 (2) 证据表明,这种影响是针对边界的,而不是一概拒绝:281项合理索赔的自动不实拒绝率为1.1%(维尔森上方约束为3.09%),目标18项(c)项的重新检查(标注为3加15接受)在两次会议上得出0/18和1/18的不实拒绝;这一选定的样本不是人口一级的真实FP估计数。 (3)最后决定与观察到的主动检查之间的行为分离:培训方法改进了最终拒绝/接受,而没有推断-时间验证器,而H3测定中的主动数字/计算检查仍然接近零。 SFT饱和使得GRPO增量无法单独识别. (4)预注册机制裁定,赞成训练-标志内化(H2)作为最佳支持,未经证实,加上保留负面控制(带有正确配对的标签渗漏不会在清洁投入上崩溃;R5倒置),并明确分离原冻结,后增量,追溯映射.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: A fast-growing family shows that reinforcement learning with a decidable signal can teach models to refuse or request information when a premise is objectively missing or an answer is verifiable: Abstain-R1 ( Zhai et al., 2026 ) , ACA-RL ( Tong et al., 2026 ) , GRIL ( Qiu et al., 2026 ) , Reinforced Hesitation ( Mohamadi et al., 2025 ) , CaRL ( Guan et al., 2026 ) , and TruthRL ( Wei et al., 2025 ) . These studies operate on anchored tasks (missing premises, verifiable success/failure, capability boundaries). None enters the no-formal-answer judgment domain studied here.
blocks.zh: 一个快速成长的家庭表明,使用可解析信号的强化学习可以在一个前提客观上缺失或者一个答案可以核实的情况下,教模型拒绝或要求信息: Abstain-R1(Zhai等人,2026年),ACA-RL(Tong等人,2026年),GRIL(Quu等人,2026年),强化的Hesitation(Mohamadi等人,2025年),CARL(Guan等人,2026年),以及TrealRL(Wei等人,2025年). 这些研究是针对固定任务(缺少房地、可核实的成功/失败、能力界限)。 这里所研究的无正式答案的判断域中,没有一个进入.

blocks.en: JTS ( Gu et al., 2026 ) is the closest neighbor: it uses an automatic judge for “cannot judge” behavior and reports human spot-checks. We do not claim that our study adds human review, and we do not describe JTS as lacking human validation. Both studies rely on model-generated judgments for scale; our distinction is the combination of arm-label masking, a separate valid/false-positive face, targeted rechecks with disclosed ambiguity, and explicit limits on what model-rating sessions can establish. This is a methodological difference, not an independent human-expert advantage.
blocks.zh: JTS(Gu et al.,2026年)是近邻:它使用自动法官来“判断”行为,并报告人体抽查。 我们并不声称我们的研究增加了人文审查,我们也不认为JTS缺乏人文验证. 这两项研究都依赖模型生成的尺度判断;我们的区别在于臂标遮盖的组合,一个单独的有效/假阳性面孔,有的放矢地重新检查并披露模糊之处,以及对模型评分会议可以确定的明确限制. 这是一种方法上的区别,而不是独立的人-专家优势.

blocks.en: The GRPO spurious-advantage analysis ( Wang et al., 2026 ) and recognition–refusal work ( Du and Hu, 2026 ) identify shortcut and misalignment risks in reward-trained refusal. We treat these as neighboring risks, not as predictions of our specific auto-judge/blind divergence; the latter is an observation in our data and its mechanism link is inferential. The abstention-collapse law ( Che et al., 2026 ) motivates our valid/false-positive face and the pre-registered FP gate. Subjective-task results ( Dong et al., 2026 ) and outcome-only RL ( Pu et al., 2026 ) frame the broader tension between anchored and unanchored criteria.
blocks.zh: GRPO的虚假优势分析(Wang等人,2026年)和表彰 - 反驳工作(Du and Hu,2026年)在奖励训练的拒绝中确定了捷径和错位风险. 我们将这些风险视为邻里风险,而不是作为对我们具体的自动判断/盲差的预测;后者是我们数据中的一个观察,其机制联系是推论性的。 弃权法(Che等人,2026年)激发了我们有效/虚假的面孔和预先注册的FP大门。 主观任务结果(Dong 等人,2026年)和结果唯一的RL(Pu 等人,2026年)规定了锚定标准与无锚定标准之间的更广泛的紧张关系。

blocks.en: Prior work on emergent abilities warns that discontinuous metrics can create apparent jumps ( Schaeffer et al., 2023 ) . We therefore report counts, denominators, and Wilson intervals, and separate automatic from model-session ratings.
blocks.zh: 先前关于突发性能力的工作警告说,不连续的度量可以产生明显的跳跃(Schaeffer等人,2023年). 因此,我们报告计数,分母,和威尔逊的间隔,以及从模型会场的自动评分中分离出来.

blocks.en: 3 Design
blocks.zh: 3 设计

blocks.en: 3.1 Construct and faces
blocks.zh: 3.1 建筑和面孔

blocks.en: Boundary-keeping in evidence-sufficiency judgment is scored on claim-evaluation tasks with statistical defects (confounding, non-response, survivorship, affirming the consequent, common cause). Two instruction faces separate the construct of interest from its invited shadow: invited (explicit “evaluate whether the claim holds”) and spontaneous (action pressure: “act on this analysis”, with no evaluation invitation). The load-bearing target is the spontaneous face. Action pressure is not sycophancy pressure: sycophancy work studies agreement with a user’s stated opinion ( Sharma et al., 2023 ) , whereas our prompts state no opinion to agree with; they instruct acting on an analysis whose evidentiary basis is defective.
blocks.zh: 在证据充分性判断中,对有统计缺陷(发现、不答复、生存、确认随之而来的共同原因)的索赔评估任务进行划界。 两项指示将利息的构成与其邀请的阴影分开:邀请(明确“评价索赔是否成立”)和自发(行动压力:“对这一分析采取行动”,没有邀请评估)。 负载目标为自发面孔. 动作压力不是节奏压力:节奏工作协议与用户的意见一致(Sharma等人,2023年),而我们则不表示同意;他们根据证据有缺陷的分析指示行动。

blocks.en: 3.2 Arms
blocks.zh: 3.2 军火

blocks.en: (a) Instruction-tuned baseline (Qwen2.5-14B). (b) General-purpose reasoning distillation (R1-Distill-14B), a no-boundary-specific-signal control. (c) Boundary-keeping reward: SFT then GRPO on an LLM-judge reward over declare/refuse/accept, with an accept-N = − 1 =-1 false-positive penalty. (d) Scrambled-pairing placebo: identical pipeline with claim–answer pairings broken. All same-base arms use Qwen2.5-14B; (b) shares the R1 family used as judge.
blocks.zh: (a) 指令调整基准(Quen2.5-14B)。 (b) 通用推理蒸馏(R1-Distill-14B),一种无边界特定信号控制。 (c) 边界维持奖励:然后由LLM法官对申报/拒绝/接受给予奖励的SFT GRPO,接受-N=======-1假阳性处罚。 (d) 冲洗-铺设安慰剂:与索赔-答对中断的相同管道。 所有同基武器都使用Quen2.5-14B; (b) 与R1家族同为法官。

blocks.en: 3.3 Pre-registration, increments, and retrospective mapping
blocks.zh: 3.3 预先登记、增量和追溯性绘图

blocks.en: The main prediction card was frozen on 2026-09-01, before formal reward results. It fixed arms, thresholds, and the R1–R8 prediction set. Several measurement faces were added later as separate operational cards, and some design elements are retrospective mapping rather than original pre-registration. Table 1 separates these layers. In particular, the GRPO spurious-advantage paper ( Wang et al., 2026 ) first appeared on 2026-09-03, after the 2026-09-01 freeze; it cannot be claimed as a pre-freeze prior. The table records timing as documented locally; it is not a third-party notarization.
blocks.zh: 主预告卡于2026-09-01年被冻结,在正式的奖励结果之前. 它固定了武器、阈值和R1-R8的预测。 后来又增加了几个测量面作为单独的操作卡,一些设计元素是追溯绘图,而不是原来的预先登记. 表1将这些层分开。 特别是,GRPO假冒-优势纸(Wang等人,2026年)最早出现于2026-09-03年,即2026-09-01冻结后;不能声称是预先冻结. 该表记录的是当地记录的时间;它不是第三方公证。

blocks.en: Table 1: Freeze, increment, and retrospective mapping. “Original” means fixed before formal reward results; “increment” means a later operational card; “retrospective” means an interpretation written after data existed.
blocks.zh: 表1:冻结、增量和追溯绘图。 “原件”是指在正式奖励结果出现之前固定的;“递增”是指以后的作业卡;“回顾”是指在数据存在之后所作的解释。

blocks.en: 3.4 Measurement, masking, and the judge problem
blocks.zh: 3.4 计量、蒙面和法官问题

blocks.en: The trained-arm reward used an automatic judge (R1-Distill-14B, declare/refuse/accept rubric). Automatic judges are untrustworthy on this material: the placebo arm scores 56.2% “correct” under the automatic rubric versus 5.0% under model-session rating. All load-bearing outcomes were therefore rated by two separate model-rating sessions with arm labels masked. The model families and exact versions behind the two sessions were not recorded in the rating files, and we report that gap rather than inferring them. The arm key was kept local and was not distributed with the rating package. The sessions did not see the meta, model labels, or trend; they saw content-only packets with the final segment, not the reasoning trace. The two sessions agreed on 160/160 spontaneous-face items ( κ = 1.0 \kappa=1.0 ), 22/24 on the targeted false-positive packet ( κ = 0.704 \kappa=0.704 ), and 100/150 on the anchored A-type packet ( κ = 0.347 \kappa=0.347 , a systematic rubric-boundary divergence). A third adjudicator resolved a small number of named disagreements; item-level records are in the local audit package, not this public version, and we do not describe this as full human review. These are model-rating sessions, not two independent human domain experts; the study therefore does not establish human-expert reliability or scientific truth.
blocks.zh: 训练有素的武器奖励使用自动法官(R1-Distill-14B,声明/背信/接受标记)。 自动裁判员对这些材料不可信:安慰剂臂在自动标语下评分为56.2%“正确”,而在模型会话评分下评分为5.0%。 因此,所有负载结果都通过两个不同的模型评分会进行评分,并蒙上臂标。 两会背后的模范家庭和确切版本没有记录在评分文件中,我们报告这一差距而不是推断. 臂键保存在本地,没有随评级包一起分发. 会议没有看到元,模型标签,也没有看到趋势;他们看到只有内容包的片段,而不是推理痕迹. 两届会议商定了160/160个自发项目(1.0\kappa=1.0),22/24个目标假阳性项目(0.704\kappa=0.704),100/150个锚定的A类项目(0.347\kappa=0.347,系统性的分界线)。 第三个裁决者解决了少量有名的分歧;项目一级的记录是在当地审计包中,而不是这个公开版本,我们不认为这是全面的人文审查。 这些都是模型评分会议,不是两个独立的人类领域专家;因此,研究报告没有确定人类专家的可靠性或科学真理。

blocks.en: 3.5 Claims
blocks.zh: 3.5 索赔

blocks.en: In the original card, only H2 implies the full conjunctive pattern; the full pattern is not all directly confirmed by the data (Table 3 ). Verdicts are best-supported, never proven. We do not claim causality beyond the tested family, process-level verification, persistence across un-mounting or time, or cross-family generality.
blocks.zh: 在最初的卡片中,只有H2暗示了完整的交联图案;完整的图案并非全部直接被数据确认(表3 ). 判决得到最好的支持,从未被证实. 我们并不声称因果关系超出经过检验的家庭范围、程序层面的核实、跨越未挂载或时间的持久性、或跨家庭的普遍性。

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: Numbers are model-session ratings unless marked automatic; per-number sources and denominators are in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 数字是模式片段评分,除非有自动标记;每个数字来源和分母载于附录A。

blocks.en: 4.1 Invited face
blocks.zh: 4.1 邀请面孔

blocks.en: On the invited face, baseline correct refusal is already high (75–85% across the two sessions). The near-zero anchor of the original prediction came from the un-invited setting and did not transfer. Arm (c) reaches 100% on both clean and in-distribution faces; (b) does not rise above baseline (60–75 vs. 75–85); (d) collapses to 7.5%. The invited face therefore cannot discriminate the training effect from a high, invitation-supported baseline; it is reported for completeness, and the load-bearing move is to the spontaneous face.
blocks.zh: 在被邀请的面面上,正确的基线拒绝率已经很高(两届都为75%-85%)。 最初预测的近零锚来自未邀请的设定,没有转移. 武装(c)在清洁和分配面上达到100%;(b)没有超过基线(60-75对75-85);(d)崩溃到7.5%。 因此,受邀请的面孔不能将培训效果与高额的、受邀请支持的基线区分开来;报告内容是完整的,负载动作是自发的。

blocks.en: 4.2 Spontaneous face
blocks.zh: 4.2 自发面孔

blocks.en: Under action pressure with no evaluation invitation, arm rates are (a) 25%, (b) 10%, (c) 100%, (d) 5% (model-session ratings, 40 per arm, κ = 1.0 \kappa=1.0 ; Table 2 , Figure 1 ). The c–a difference is 0.75; Wilson intervals [91.2, 100] and [14.2, 40.2] do not overlap. Arm (c)’s refusals name the specific defect of each item (confound, non-response, survivorship, affirming the consequent, common cause) rather than issuing generic refusal. This is the load-bearing result: spontaneous boundary-keeping is trainable in a no-formal-answer domain.
blocks.zh: 在没有评价邀请书的行动压力下,臂率是(a) 25%,(b) 10%,(c) 100%,(d) 5%(模片评分,每臂40分,=1.0\kappa=1.0;表2,图1)。 c-a的差值为0.75;Wilson的间隔[91.2,100]和[14.2,40.2]没有重叠. Arm(c)拒绝列出每一物品的具体缺陷(发现、不答复、幸存、确认随之而来的共同原因),而不是发出一般性拒绝。 这就是负载的结果:自发的边界保持可以在不正式的回答域中训练.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Invited and spontaneous faces. Invited bars show the range across two model-rating sessions (not a confidence interval); spontaneous bars show point estimates with Wilson 95% CIs for (a) and (c). n=40 per arm.
blocks.zh: 图1:受邀和自发的面孔。 特邀栏显示两个模型评分会话的范围(不是置信间隔);自发栏显示的点数估计数为(a)和(c)的Wilson 95% CI。 n=每臂40个.

blocks.en: 4.3 Valid face: specificity, not blanket refusal
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 有效面貌:具体性,而不是一概拒绝

blocks.en: The effect is boundary-specific rather than blanket refusal. On 281 well-formed claims (276 in-distribution, 5 held-out), automatic false refusal is (c) 1.1% (3/281; Wilson upper bound 3.09%), (a) 8.9%, (b) 28.5% (270 valid; 11 judge-error rows excluded), and (d) 91.1% (Figure 2 ). The targeted 24-item packet contained 18 items from arm (c), including all three auto-flagged items and 15 auto-accepted items, plus three flagged items each from (a) and (d). The (c) rechecks yielded 0/18 and 1/18 false refusals across the sessions. This was a selected sample, not a re-rating of the full 281-item population; the other 263 (c) items were not re-rated. The five held-out valid claims are accepted by (c) with no false refusal; this is a small check, not proof against memorization. The placebo’s 91.1% is the pathological collapse pattern: broken pairings train rejection, not judgment.
blocks.zh: 其效果是具体边界,而不是一概拒绝。 在281项理顺的索赔(276项分配,5项搁置)中,自动拒付是:(c)1.1%(3/281项;Wilson上行3.09%);(a)8.9%;(b)28.5%(270项有效;11项法官-错误排除外);(d)91.1%(图2)。 目标24个物品包载有来自(c)臂的18个物品,包括所有3个自动标记物品和15个自动接受物品,加上3个标记物品,每个标记物品来自(a)和(d)。 (c) 重新检查的结果是,在整个会议期间有0/18和1/18次虚假拒绝。 这是选定的样本,而不是重新评定全部281项;其他263(c)项没有重新评定。 (c) 接受5项被搁置的有效索赔,没有虚假的拒绝;这是一次小检查,不是不利于赔偿的证据。 安慰剂91.1%是病理崩溃模式:断配对火车拒绝,而不是判断.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Valid-face false refusal. (b) uses n=270 because 11 judge-error rows were excluded; (a), (c), and (d) use n=281. (c) is 3/281 = 1.1% with Wilson upper bound 3.09%; the targeted recheck is not a population-level true-FP estimate.
blocks.zh: 图2:有效面部虚假拒绝。 (b) 使用n=270,因为排除了11行法官-误差;(a)、(c)和(d)使用n=281.(c)为3/281=1.1%,而Wilson上行为3.09%;目标重新检查不是人口一级的真实-FP估计数。

blocks.en: 4.4 Guard gap and process check
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 守卫缺口和进程检查

blocks.en: The guard-criterion gap (declared insufficiency minus correct refusal) is 0.00 for (c): speech and behavior rise together, so the reward was not learned as a new format shell. Under the stricter process criterion (H3: active numeric/calculation verification), all four arms are near zero (25/25 item-level N on clean; one Y in the in-distribution b arm). Reward bought final boundary-keeping status, not chain-of-thought self-checking; we report this as an independent finding, not a footnote.
blocks.zh: (c) 警卫-标准差距(宣布不足/正确拒绝)为0.00:言论和行为一起上升,因此奖励没有作为新的格式外壳学习. 根据更严格的工艺标准(H3:主动数/计算核查),所有四件武器都接近零(25/25项N级清理;1Y级分配b臂)。 奖赏购买了最后的边界保存状态,而不是思索的自我检查链;我们将此报告为独立调查结果,而不是脚注。

blocks.en: 4.5 Honest negative: label leakage
blocks.zh: 4.5 国家 诚实否定:标签渗漏

blocks.en: Training on gold labels whose prompts embed the judgment criterion, with correct pairings (c-leak), does not collapse on clean inputs: cue-present automatic refusal is 100% (declare 99.7%), clean automatic is 98.8%, and clean model-session ratings are 95–97.5%. The cue-minus-clean difference is about 2.5–5 points, below the pre-registered .10 collapse threshold; the pre-registered falsification condition is met. The collapse risk sits in broken pairings (the placebo), not in cue presence. Label leakage remains a data-integrity problem, but the behavioral theater prediction is not supported (Figure 3 ).
blocks.zh: 以正确配对(c-leak)作为判断标准基础的金色标签培训不会在干净的投入上崩溃:cue-present自动拒绝率为100%(99.7%),干净自动率为98.8%,干净的模型片段评级为95-97.5%。 cue-minus-clean的差值约为2.5–5分,低于预先注册的10倒塌阈值;提前注册的伪造条件得到满足. 倒塌的风险在于断裂的配对(安慰剂),而不是提示。 标签泄漏仍然是一个数据集成问题,但行为剧场预测不支持(图3 ).

blocks.en: Figure 3: R6 leakage control. Cue and clean automatic rates are shown; clean model-session ratings are 95–97.5% across two sessions. Correct-pairing leakage does not collapse on clean inputs; the collapse risk sits in the scrambled-pairing placebo.
blocks.zh: 图3:R6渗漏控制。 显示的是清洁和清洁的自动费率;在两届中,清洁的模版评分为95-97.5%。 正确铺垫的渗漏不会在干净的输入物上崩溃;坍塌的风险位于铺垫的安慰剂中。

blocks.en: 4.6 Decomposition and the GRPO increment
blocks.zh: 4.6 分解和GPRO递增

blocks.en: SFT-only checkpoints reach 100% on both faces; on the spontaneous face the SFT checkpoint is blind-confirmed at 100% (40/40, two sessions, κ = 1.0 \kappa=1.0 ), identical to the GRPO arm. GRPO therefore adds no separable increment at this protocol: the spontaneous face is SFT-saturated, so the reported effect is the joint SFT+GRPO effect whose primary carrier is SFT. This is a measurement limit of a saturated face, not evidence about GRPO.
blocks.zh: 只有SFT的检查站在两面都达到100%;在自发的脸上,SFT检查站被盲目确认为100%(40,两场,=1.0\kappa=1.0),与GRPO手臂完全相同。 GRPO因此在本协议中不添加可分离增量:自发面是SFT-饱和的,因此报告的效果是SFT+GRPO的联合效应,其主要载体是SFT. 这是饱和面部的测量极限,不是GRPO的证据.

blocks.en: Table 2: Main aggregate results. Model-session ratings unless marked auto. Invited values are session ranges; spontaneous values are point estimates with Wilson CIs for (a) and (c). b’s valid denominator is 270; a, c, d use 281.
blocks.zh: 表2:主要总结果。 模型片段的评分,除非有标记的自动. 邀请值为会话范围;自发值为(a)和(c)与Wilson CIs的点估计值。 b 有效分母为270;a、c、d使用281。

blocks.en: 5 Mechanism Adjudication
blocks.zh: 5 机制裁决

blocks.en: The original prediction card’s full conjunctive pattern was not all directly confirmed (Table 3 ). The general-purpose reasoning-distillation arm (b) does not raise boundary-keeping above baseline on either face, which does not support the tested general-RL account (H3). The resilience-rebound account (H1) was not tested by a scorer-removal or washout experiment. H2 (training-signal internalization) is best-supported: (b) does not raise, (c) does, and the guard gap converges; the scorer-removal leg is closed architecturally (no inference-time scorer) but the rebound/washout experiment was not run; the size leg is underpowered. The full conjunct is therefore not all directly confirmed, and H2 remains best-supported, not proven. The older 32B line and this knock-in converge on the role of the training signal, but they are not replicates.
blocks.zh: 最初的预测卡的完全连结模式并没有全部直接得到确认(表3). 通用推理-稀释臂(b)不会在两个面上使边界保持高于基线,这不能支持经测试的一般-RL账户(H3)。 恢复能力账户(H1)没有经过记分员清除或冲洗实验测试。 H2(训练-信号内化)得到最好的支持:(b)不提高,(c)有,守备缺口会汇合;计分员-移除的腿在建筑上是封闭的(没有推断-时间计分员),但反弹/洗涤实验没有运行;尺寸腿力不足. 因此,并非全部直接确认,H2仍然得到最好的支持,没有证明。 更古老的32B线和这款敲门机在训练信号的作用上汇合,但它们不是复制的.

blocks.en: Table 3: Original prediction-card components and observed support. The full conjunctive pattern is not all directly confirmed; H2 is best-supported, not proven.
blocks.zh: 表3:原始预测卡组件和观察到的支持。 完整的连结模式并非全部直接确认;H2得到最好的支持,没有被证明.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: A pre-registered anchored comparison found the unanchored gain larger than the anchored gain (mixed-criterion Δ \Delta : anchored + 0.28 +0.28 vs. unanchored + 0.75 +0.75 ; signed five-tier reading = direction reversal, 95% CI excludes zero on the pre-registered mixed criterion). The robustness on the mixed criterion holds across all three A-type rating definitions; the declare-only isomorphism is directionally consistent but underpowered and is not claimed. The reversal partially reflects ceiling arithmetic on the unanchored side; the declare-only baselines are near-equal, which partially excludes a baseline-artifact explanation but not decisively. Within the anchored layer, the reward’s entire margin sits in declare behavior (+.58) with zero solve increment ( − .02 -.02 ): training bought boundary-keeping, not problem-solving, the same dissociation as H3 ≈ 0 \approx 0 .
blocks.zh: 预先注册的锚定比较发现无锚定收益大于锚定收益(mixed-criterion QQ\Delta : 锚定+0.28+0.28 vs. unanchored + 0.75+0.75;签名的五级读数=方向逆转,95% CI在预先注册的混合标准上排除0). 混合标准的强性贯穿于所有三个A类评级定义中;只申报的异形主义方向一致,但力量不足,不主张。 颠倒部分反映了未确定一侧的上限算术;只申报的基线几乎相等,其中部分排除了基线动因解释,但并不果断。 在锚地层中,奖励的全差在于宣布行为(+.58),零解增量(−.02-.02):训练购买的边界保存,而不是解决问题,与H3 \\ 0\大约0.

blocks.en: R6 and the H3 null are findings, not footnotes. Of the eight pre-registered prediction items, two were directionally corrected (R5 reversed; R6 falsified as a pre-registered negative), and one within-R1 sub-assumption (the placebo’s neutrality) was corrected. Each is recorded with its disposition; falsification and hits are reported with equal weight.
blocks.zh: R6和H3无效是调查结果,而不是脚注。 在预先登记的8个预测项目中,有2个是方向改正的(R5倒置;R6是伪造的预先登记的负数),1个是R1内部的分吸(安慰剂的中立性),已经改正。 每种都按其处置方式记录;伪造和击中报告重量相同。

blocks.en: 7 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 限制

blocks.en: • Size evidence is descriptive. The reward arm transfers at three same-family points (7B/14B/32B; g ≈ 0.525 / 0.750 / 0.738 g\approx 0.525/0.750/0.738 ), but the adjacent pairwise differences do not exclude zero (7B vs. 14B: 95% CI [ − 0.455 -0.455 , + 0.005 +0.005 ]; 14B vs. 32B: [ − 0.186 -0.186 , + 0.161 +0.161 ]). The trend is underpowered; no monotone, peak, or plateau claim is made. The 32B result is a transfer point, not a replication. • Stage decomposition resolves at ceiling. SFT saturates the spontaneous face (blind 40/40), so the GRPO increment is not separately identifiable; the invited face remains automatically scored only. • Persistence is untested. Un-mounting rebound and temporal washout are not measured in this architecture. • Rating sessions are not human experts. The two sessions are model-rating sessions; model families and exact versions were not recorded. κ \kappa values describe their agreement, not scientific truth or human-expert reliability. A third adjudicator resolved named disagreements; this is not full human review. • False-positive inference is limited. The 1.1% automatic rate has a Wilson upper bound of 3.09%. The targeted 24-item packet contained 18 arm-(c) items (3 auto-flagged + 15 auto-accepted), plus 3 flagged items each from (a) and (d); the (c) rechecks yielded 0/18 and 1/18 false refusals. This selected sample does not establish a population-level true FP of zero; 263 (c) items were not re-rated. The five held-out valid items are a small check. • No process-level verification was purchased. H3 ≈ 0 \approx 0 across arms is an independent finding, not a footnote. • Anchored-layer granularity is low. The R5 declare-only face is underpowered; some anchored items have per-item n = 2 n=2 and are observation-only. • Single-family scope. No cross-family or cross-scale generalization is claimed. • Robustness is descriptive. The prefix-pressure probe is scoped to its gradient set, with non-monotonic intermediate points, ignored pressure sentences, and an unreliable automatic judge on the benign-control face. It is not a general robustness certification.
blocks.zh: • 支助 尺寸证据是描述性的. 3个相同家庭点(7B/14B/32B;g 0.525 / 0.750 / 0.738 g\\ 0.525/0.750/0.738)的奖励臂转移,但相邻的对称差异不排除0(7B对14B:95% CI [−0.455-0.455,+0.005+0.005]];14B对32B:[−0.186-0.186,+0.161]]) 趋势不足;没有单质、峰或高原索赔。 32B的结果是一个转移点,而不是复制. • 分阶段分解在上限解决。 SFT饱和自发面(blind 40/40),因此GRPO增量无法单独识别;邀请面仍然仅自动得分. • 持久性未经检验。 失载反弹和时空冲洗在这个架构中没有测量. • 支助 评分课不是人类专家。 这两场会议是模式评分会议;模范家庭和准确版本没有记录. $\kappa 值描述它们的一致,而不是科学的真理或人类专家的可靠性. 第三个裁决者解决了所谓的分歧;这不是全面的人类审查。 • 虚假的推断有限。 1.1%的自动率的上限为3.09%的威尔逊. 目标24项包装有18项臂(c)项(3项自动悬挂+15项自动接受),加上(a)和(d)项各3项标记的物品;(c)重新检查的结果是0/18项和1/18项错误拒绝。 所选的样本没有确定人口一级的实际FP为0;263(c)项没有重新评级。 5个被搁置的有效物品是小支票. • 支助 未购买进程一级的核查。 H3 ≈ 0 \ 0 approx 0  across 0  is  is  is  is  is  is  is  is  is  is  is  is  is  is  is  is  is  is  is  is  is ≈ ≈  is  is  is  is  is  is ≈ ≈ ≈ ≈ ≈  is ≈ ≈ ≈ ≈ ≈ ≈ ≈ ≈ ≈ ≈ ≈ ≈ ≈ ≈ ≈ ≈ ≈ ≈ ≈ ≈ ≈ ≈ ≈ ≈ ≈ ≈ ≈ ≈ ≈ ≈ ≈ ≈ ≈ ≈ ≈ ≈ ≈ ≈  is  is ≈  is  is  is  is  is  is  is  arms  is  is  arms  arms  arms  is  arms  is  is  is  is  arms  is  is  is  is  is  is  is  is  is  arms  arms  arms  arms  arms  arms  arms  arms  arms  arms  arms  arms  arms  arms  arms  arms · 悬浮层颗粒性低。 R5只声明的面部力量不足;一些锚定的物件有每个项n=2n=2,并且只观察. • 单一家庭范围。 没有关于跨家庭或跨规模的概括性索赔。 • 强健是描述性的。 前缀压力探测器被扩展到它的梯度集,非模态中间点,忽略压力句,在良性控制面上有一个不可靠的自动判断器. 这不是一个普遍有力的证明。

blocks.en: 8 Data, Code, and Ethics
blocks.zh: 8 数据、守则和道德操守

blocks.en: Aggregate readouts, figure-generation code, and public protocol/rubric summaries are archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23661668 . This artifact supports regeneration of aggregate figures, not full replication of the study. Raw outputs, model-rating files, arm keys, held-out items, and item-level adjudication records are not released. Code is licensed under MIT; aggregate data, documentation, and figures are licensed under CC BY 4.0, as specified in the artifact’s per-file license map. No “available on request” release is promised for the unreleased raw materials. The local audit trail binds artifacts by content hashes and records the freeze/increment layers; those records are not a third-party notarization. The study uses model-generated text and model-rating sessions only; it involves no human-subject data and no IRB approval. The author designed the study, decided the claims and stop conditions, and is responsible for the final text. An internal engineering agent performed the main implementation, test execution, and batch runs; a separate internal review agent performed evidence and code checks. The two rating sessions are AI model sessions, not human reviewers. No external domain-expert review or ethics approval is claimed.
blocks.zh: 总计读数、数字生成代码和公共协议/Rubric摘要存档于https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23661668。 该文物支持汇总数字的再生,而不是该研究的完全复制. 原始输出,模型评分文件,臂键,搁置项目,以及项目级裁定记录不发布. 密码由麻省理工学院颁发;汇总数据、文件和数字由CC BY 4.0颁发,具体内容见文物每个档案的许可证地图。 对于未释放的原材料,没有保证“可索取的”释放。 当地审计线索通过内容散列将文物捆绑起来,记录冻结/递增层;这些记录不是第三方公证。 该研究仅使用模型生成的文本和模型评分会议;它不涉及人主体数据,也不涉及IRB批准. 作者设计了研究,决定了诉求并停止了条件,并对最后文本负责. 一个内部工程代理进行了主要执行、测试执行和批量运行;一个单独的内部审查代理进行了证据和密码检查。 两个评分课是AI模式课,而不是人文审查员. 没有要求外部领域专家审查或道德操守批准。

blocks.en: The two sessions were separate model-rating sessions (one file-delivered, one inline). Their model families and exact versions were not recorded; the paper does not infer them. The arm key was local and not distributed. The sessions saw content-only packets with arm labels masked. Agreement: 160/160 on the spontaneous face ( κ = 1.0 \kappa=1.0 ), 22/24 on the targeted FP packet ( κ = 0.704 \kappa=0.704 ), and 100/150 on the anchored A-type packet ( κ = 0.347 \kappa=0.347 ). A third adjudicator resolved the named disagreements; item-level records are in the local audit package, not in this public version.
blocks.zh: 这两届会议是单独的模式评分会议(一个文件交付,一个内含)。 他们的模范家族和确切的版本没有被记录;论文没有推断他们. 臂键是局部的,没有分发。 会话中看到只包含内容的包,臂标签被蒙住. 协议:160/160在自发面额上(=1.0\kappa=1.0),22/24在目标FP包上(=0.704\kappa=0.704),100/150在锚定的A型包上(=0.347\kappa=0.347). 第三裁决者解决了点名的分歧;项目级记录在本地审计包中,而不是在本公开版本中.

blocks.en: AI contribution and ethics
blocks.zh: AI 贡献和道德

blocks.en: The author designed the study, selected the claims and stop conditions, and is responsible for the final text. An internal engineering agent performed the main implementation, test execution, and batch runs; a separate internal review agent performed evidence and code checks. The two rating sessions are model sessions, not human reviewers. No external domain-expert review or ethics approval is claimed.
blocks.zh: 作者设计了研究,选择了诉求并停止了条件,负责最终文本. 一个内部工程代理进行了主要执行、测试执行和批量运行;一个单独的内部审查代理进行了证据和密码检查。 两个评分会议是示范会议,而不是人文审查. 没有要求外部领域专家审查或道德操守批准。
